_note: Query 17: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-04-01,End=2026-05-01 --granularity MONTHLY --metrics AmortizedCost --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"RECORD_TYPE","Values":["Usage","DiscountedUsage","SavingsPlanCoveredUsage"]}}' --group-by Type=TAG,Key=Service Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE (the 'Service$' key = tag value empty = untagged). No commitment applies to the untagged lines, so the amounts are the same under either cost metric. Untagged is a visibility finding, not waste: reported under Informational / excluded, no savings claimed. Total 8,000.00 = 5,200.00 + 1,800.00 + 1,000.00.
